description: Building a lightweight, automated telemetry tool that hooks directly into real-time NASA (DONKI) and NOAA (SWPC) feeds. It processes incoming space weather data (solar flares, geomagnetic indices) through a rule-based impact engine to translate raw metrics into actionable operational risks for GPS, aviation, and power grids. Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, Streamlit, REST APIs.
summary: ORBITAL is a real-time heliophysics mission engineering and decision-support platform that translates raw solar wind and geomagnetic telemetry into actionable risk intelligence for Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite operators and transpolar aviation dispatchers. By integrating live data from NASA’s DONKI solar flare database and NOAA’s DSCOVR spacecraft at Lagrange Point 1, ORBITAL computes the Newell Solar Wind–Magnetosphere Coupling Function to forecast Planetary Kp trajectories before geomagnetic storms strike Earth. Operators can visualize 3D orbital intersections with expanding auroral scintillation zones, compare fleet-wide thermospheric drag and propellant penalties, reroute polar flights around high-frequency radio blackouts, and consult an integrated Gemini-powered AI Flight Director for instant operational directives.
details:
WHAT IT DOES & HOW IT WORKS

ORBITAL bridges the gap between raw heliophysics telemetry and mission-critical operational decisions. Instead of forcing engineers and flight dispatchers to manually interpret disconnected space weather feeds, ORBITAL ingests real-time Interplanetary Magnetic Field (IMF Bz/Bt) and solar wind velocity data from NOAA’s DSCOVR satellite at Lagrange Point 1 (1.5 million km upstream), alongside live solar flare coordinates from NASA’s DONKI API.

Using these live inputs (or interactive G2, G4, and G5 storm simulations), ORBITAL evaluates the Newell Solar Wind–Magnetosphere Coupling Function (dΦ_MP/dt = v^(4/3) * B_T^(2/3) * sin^(8/3)(θ_c / 2)) to determine L1 propagation lead time and project a 3-hour Planetary Kp forecast. The platform translates these physics outputs into four interactive workspaces:

1. 3D Orbital & Kp Forecast: Renders an interactive 3D Earth and spacecraft trajectory (including the ISS, Hubble, Starlink, and Sentinel-6), dynamically expanding the auroral oval equatorward as Kp rises and flagging exact GNSS scintillation blackout intersections.

2. Multi-Satellite Fleet Risk Matrix: Computes exponential thermospheric neutral density expansion to predict daily altitude decay (m/day) and station-keeping propellant penalties (kg/day) across multiple LEO constellations simultaneously.

3. Transpolar Aviation Reroute Planner: Models Polar Cap Absorption (PCA) high-frequency radio attenuation (dB) over transpolar corridors (such as JFK–HND and DXB–SFO), recommending southward diversions with exact delay minutes, extra Jet-A1 fuel burn, and estimated USD reroute costs, plus a downloadable dispatch briefing.

4. Heliographic Solar Disk & DONKI Flares: Maps active X- and M-class solar flares directly onto heliographic coordinates alongside live NOAA SWPC alerts.

BENEFITS & INTENDED IMPACT

Geomagnetic storms can trigger unexpected satellite orbital decay, GNSS navigation loss, and polar aviation communication blackouts. ORBITAL empowers satellite mission controllers and airline dispatchers with clear, quantified go/no-go operational thresholds—protecting spacecraft hardware, conserving station-keeping propellant, and ensuring safe polar flight routing.

TOOLS, LANGUAGES & SUPER INTELLIGENCE (SI) DISCLOSURE

- Languages & Frameworks: Python, Streamlit, Plotly (3D Surface/Scattergeo), NumPy, Pandas, HTML/CSS/JavaScript.

- Live Data APIs: NASA DONKI (Solar Flare API) and NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (SWPC) Real-Time Solar Wind & Planetary K-Index feeds.

- Super Intelligence (SI) Integration & Disclosure: ORBITAL includes an embedded "Orbital AI Flight Director" powered by Google Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash) to summarize live telemetry and answer operator queries. Generative AI assistance was also utilized during development to accelerate UI styling and code structuring.
